notes: Budget of 30 searches/fetches used in full. The prescribed per-network set (7 standard queries plus 2 network-specific terms x 8 networks = 72 queries) could NOT be run; queries were consolidated across networks and weighted toward institutional sources, and the ledger records what actually ran. Stack Overflow returned no on-topic items for any network (hits were word-fragment matches such as 'interace' or generic terminal integration; rupay 0). Reddit JSON endpoints returned a login wall, so 0 items. Wayback availability lookups were not run (budget), so every archive_url is null. G2/Capterra/TrustRadius were not checked. Unverified leads, not coded because no verbatim quote was retrieved: Payments Council of India letter to the PM (March 2025) asking for MDR on UPI and RuPay debit (startupnews.fyi returned 410, Business Standard 403); HDE's Ulrich Binnebössel on international debit cards crowding out girocard (reported only in a search summary); Abecs statements on Elo/brand settlement guarantees after the Entrepay liquidation (Finsiders, 2026-03-27; the brands declined to comment individually); Australian Retailers Association/NRA and COSBOA 2025 RBA submissions backing mandatory LCR; UFC-Que Choisir (September 2025) on the CB vs Visa/Mastercard merchant fee gap. Two eftpos items are RBA paraphrases of submissions, not the submitters' own words. Network-owned statements (the AP+ RBA submission, Interac fee pages) were excluded as self-description.
